newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Tonghua Pharmaceutical to issue 100 mln A shares.
newsitem.headline: Tonghua Pharmaceutical to issue 100 mln A shares.

text.p: Tonghua Jinma Pharmaceutical Co Ltd has applied to the China Securities Regulatory Commission for an initial public offering of 100 million A shares, an official concerned with the issue said on Friday.

Shenzhen International Trust & Investment Securities Co Ltd has been appointed lead underwriter for the offer, which is expected to be launched next year, an official at the Tonghua Commission for Economic Restructuring told the China Securities Bulletin, a Hong Kong-based newsletter.
The company, based in the city of Tonghua in northeastern Jilin province, expects net profits of 56 million yuan in 1996, the official said but did not give comparative figures.

The firm, whose main business is producing traditional Chinese medicine, has 140 million outstanding shares, comprising 86.80 million legal person shares and 53.20 million staff shares. If the A share offer is approved, the firm will use the proceeds to develop a new line of Chinese medical products, the official said.
China Guotai Securities will sponsor Jinma's listing on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange, he added.
